newsitem.title: GERMANY: German SPD say deficit already above '97 target.
newsitem.headline: German SPD say deficit already above '97 target.

text.p: Germany's opposition Social Democrats (SPD) on Wednesday said Chancellor Helmut Kohl's centre-right coalition government had already run up a deficit that exceeded its targets for the full year.

"The beeline drive of Kohl and (Finance Minister Theo) Waigel straight into the budget hole is continuing unabated and has hit a new negative record," said Karl Diller, SPD parliamentary finance expert.
Diller said that at the end of May, the federal deficit was already 53.4 billion marks, compared to a projected deficit for the year of 53.3 billion.
"This government has completely used up its credit," he said.
